title: Long Descriptions
description: Whether a long description survives without being cut. Tested with 1,300 characters including Unicode.
question: Do long descriptions survive without truncation?
notes: A 1,300 character Unicode description arrived intact everywhere measured.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: arrives intact, then augmented. See description fidelity.

verdict.headline: No truncation observed in any listed framework.
verdict.detail: Worth rechecking as framework and provider description limits change.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Silent truncation would remove exactly the caveats authors tend to put at the end of a description.
